# Write Vertical Blueprint

Usa `docs/14-vertical-blueprint-contracts.md` e il project profile scelto.

Pipeline ufficiale: Raw request -> Intake -> Specification -> Project Profile Selection -> Vertical Blueprint -> Plan -> Tasks -> Implementation -> Evaluation Scorecard -> Release/Iteration.

Produci un Vertical Blueprint Contract con:

- role contract;
- product intent;
- domain context;
- stack contract;
- architecture contract;
- data/content contract;
- UX/design/motion contract;
- security/privacy contract;
- performance/accessibility contract;
- output/file contract;
- implementation rules;
- test contract;
- acceptance gates;
- scorecard.

Non implementare codice finché il blueprint non supera 75/100 in `blueprints/09-blueprint-evaluation.md`.
